description: Empirical SCADA Telemetry and Simulation Dataset for 35 kW Rooftop Solar PV System in Pune, India is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Dr Vaibhav Khatavkar, Rohan Kulkarni (DES Pune University). This open-access dataset contains 12 months (35,040 intervals at 15-minute temporal resolution) of empirical operational telemetry and physics-based simulation benchmarking for an institutional 35 kW rooftop solar photovoltaic (PV) installation located at DES Pune University, Pune, India (18.5319° N, 73.8498° E). Coverage: national (IN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
